name: EverShelf
description: EverShelf is a self-hosted smart pantry manager: inventory for pantry, fridge and freezer, barcode scanning, expiry tracking with offline OCR, smart shopping lists and AI recipes (Gemini, OpenAI or a local OpenAI-compatible model). Data lives in SQLite, with built-in daily backups.

app_vars.name: var_evershelf_access
app_vars.label: Remote access
app_vars.help: lan: no remote access. tailscale: private access from your tailnet. cloudflare: public URL through a Cloudflare Tunnel (API token enforced). both: Tailscale and Cloudflare.

app_vars.name: var_tailscale_authkey
app_vars.label: Tailscale auth key
app_vars.help: Optional. Empty: sign in with a link during install.

app_vars.name: var_cloudflared_token
app_vars.label: Cloudflare Tunnel token
app_vars.help: Token of a remotely managed tunnel (Zero Trust → Networks → Tunnels). Empty: connect later with `cloudflared service install <TOKEN>`.

notes.text: Served over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate (the camera needs a secure context): accept the browser warning once. Also reachable as `https://<hostname>.local`.
Optional remote access at install: Tailscale (private, valid HTTPS via tailscale serve) and/or Cloudflare Tunnel (public; API token enforced, pair each browser with `evershelf-pairing-code`).
The first-run wizard asks for the language and the AI provider key (Gemini, OpenAI or a local model).
